bugs.summary: mkCharLenCE(): use-after-free of the CHARSXP behind the "embedded nul in string" error
bugs.creator: kevinushey

comments.creator: kevinushey
comments.text:
mkCharLenCE() (src/main/envir.c) rejects a string with an embedded nul by building a CHARSXP holding the offending bytes and passing it to EncodeString() to render the "embedded nul in string" error. That CHARSXP is not protected. When it is marked latin1 or UTF-8 and needs translating in the current locale, EncodeString() calls translateChar(), whose R_alloc() can run the garbage collector and free the CHARSXP; EncodeString() then reads it again on the next line (the p == CHAR(s) comparison, printutils.c:639). The code dates from r45435, so every release is affected, and any caller of mkCharLenCE() with such a string is exposed; unserialize() is just how the fuzzer reached it.

Reproducible example (R-devel r90604 and R 4.6.1; gctorture() makes the GC timing deterministic):

s <- strrep(iconv("\u00e9", "UTF-8", "latin1"), 30000)   # latin1, non-ASCII
r <- serialize(s, NULL)
idx <- which(r == as.raw(0xe9))
r[idx[length(idx) / 2]] <- as.raw(0)                      # embedded nul
gctorture(TRUE)
unserialize(r)
gctorture(FALSE)

Observed, in a UTF-8 locale (in a C locale use idx[length(idx) / 4], so that the translation is the same size as the CHARSXP and malloc hands the freed block straight back):

Error in unserialize(r) :
  'Rf_getCharCE' must be called on a CHARSXP, but got 'raw'

The freed CHARSXP has become the RAWSXP that R_alloc() allocated for the translation. Under AddressSanitizer it is a heap-use-after-free:

READ of size 8
    #0 R_CHAR                   memory.c:4115
    #1 Rf_EncodeString          printutils.c:639
    #2 Rf_mkCharLenCE           envir.c:4782
freed by:
    #1 ReleaseLargeFreeVectors  memory.c:1167
    #3 R_gc_internal            memory.c:3238
    #6 R_alloc                  memory.c:2333
    #8 Rf_translateChar         sysutils.c:1834
    #9 Rf_EncodeString          printutils.c:638
   #10 Rf_mkCharLenCE           envir.c:4782

Expected: the "embedded nul in string: '...'" error.

Found by OSS-Fuzz (AddressSanitizer, unserialize target), testcase 4802858911072256.

Proposed patch: attached as mkchar-embedded-nul-uaf.diff, against r90604. It PROTECTs the CHARSXP (the error unwind pops it again) and adds a regression test to tests/reg-tests-1e.R that fails without the fix in both UTF-8 and C locales; make test-Reg passes with it.

The patch is also submitted as https://github.com/r-devel/r-svn/pull/347, where CI results can be seen.

Created attachment 3880
